final_message: PJR-N22N: rewrote the 9 xrp templates to take the grade result as input (evaluation-result chapter, done-criteria table, no per-viewpoint pass/fail/unclear, no owner-only-role narrowing). Added a review-only judgement procedure (E-01 freshness via grade list --changed-only, E-02, change detection, 6-value verdict table) to xep-common-conventions-template.md; it is stripped from non-review plans. Rewrote xrr-template.md around a verdict that maps one-to-one to the 6 bps-task-completion acceptance viewpoints. Deleted both viewpoint-detail templates (staged by git rm; unstaging needs approval) and removed their code paths. Replaced review reporter output (`grade_check`/`rationale`/`improvements`/`approach`/`verdict`) in src/exec-reporter.ts, the public schema YAML, and src/exec-results.ts rendering and unfilled detection (legacy recommendation marker kept). Fixed the previous run's typecheck cause by removing `viewpointsPath` from `scaffoldClaimResult` and all its callers. Updated tests and the ticket's work and outcome sections. Generated trial review plans for pm-plan (fully-guided and rulebook-maintenance); agent-run review trial (ticket No.6) not done. review-guide.md not updated (out of scope). Temp trial plans remain in /tmp (rm needs approval).
